name: EV Charging Load from Diversity Factor (Parametric)
description: Total EV charging load is parametrically computed from the number of EVs, rated charger power, and diversity factor: P_ev = N × P_charger × f_div. Diversity factor uncertainty propagates through this formula.

elements.name: EV Charging Diversity Factor
elements.description: Fraction of EVs simultaneously charging during peak demand period.

uncertainty.source: Open Power System Data: EV charging diversity factor analysis from smart charging trials

elements.name: Feeder Maximum Load
elements.description: Feeder thermal rating at peak summer temperature: derated to 195 kW [threshold adjusted to 0.815 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.expression: P_ev = N * P_charger * f_div = 45 * 7.4 * f_div <= P_feeder_max
consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(f_div) = F·f_div + f; F = N×P_charger = 45×7.4 = 333 kW, f=0 — parametric load from diversity factor
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: EV load CZ is affine image of diversity factor CZ through P_ev = N×P_charger×f_div formula.
